text: {"headline":"Press 4 Interlock Failure, Inspection Record and Subsequent Actions – Review Brief","overview":"This brief summarizes documented records from March-April 2026 concerning Press 4, including an interlock failure and isolation, a signed safety inspection, log entries, and later remedial actions, alongside reporter allegations that remain unverified.","key_points":["Iven Pell isolated Press 4 after the interlock failed, with the timing described as the following Monday but otherwise unresolved. [C001, C002]","On 4 March 2026, PERSON_1 PERSON_1 signed the Press 4 safety inspection as complete. [C003]","The checklist reports a 0.18-second stop on all four cycles, while the issue register indicates the handheld meter was in calibration stores that morning; a green sticker alone does not establish that a functional test happened. [C008, C009, C010]","Two days after the 4 March inspection, PERSON_1 PERSON_1 instructed maintenance to copy February's guard-test readings into the March sheet. [C004]","A log dated 2 March states PERSON_1 PERSON_1 restarted Press 4 after Iven Pell isolated it, creating unresolved sequencing uncertainty relative to the isolation and inspection dates. [C007]","The production schedule shows a customer rush order but does not authorize skipping the test. [C012, C013]","In early April, PERSON_1 approved a replacement interlock for Press 4, and after the audit Iven Pell photographed the unsealed test terminal. [C005, C006]","The audit date is not on the calendar extract and remains unconfirmed, and there is no injury report in this packet. [C014, C011]"],"risk_notes":["Records indicate a restart after isolation and an instruction to copy prior test readings, with no independent verification of functional testing at the time of inspection.","Reporter allegations that the guard failed to stop the press, that the night team isolated and notified the day lead, and concerns about identical checklist readings are not independently verified by the documents and should be treated as allegations pending corroboration.","The restart log entry's date is questioned by a reporter allegation that it was already in the shared file and might be a copied template, which remains unverified and contributes to timeline uncertainty."],"limitations":["The evidence does not independently prove whether a functional guard test occurred on 4 March 2026, whether the reported 0.18-second stops are accurate, or the actual operational status of Press 4 between isolation and restart.","The evidence does not establish the exact dates of the interlock failure, isolation, audit, or photography, nor does it confirm the audit occurrence or the cause of the unsealed test terminal.","Reporter allegations regarding guard failure, notification of the day lead, motive for saving the checklist, and the origin of the restart entry date have no verified document support and cannot be treated as established facts.","Absence of an injury report in this packet is not evidence that no injury or near-miss occurred, and the packet does not show authorization or justification for skipping tests."]}
